offers_products.reason: Specialty retailer of home furnishings and cookware under brands like Williams Sonoma, Pottery Barn, West Elm.

offers_services.reason: Revenue is from retail sales of furniture and housewares; design and delivery services are incidental.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells home furnishings to households through stores, e-commerce and catalogs.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Has B2B business selling furnishings to commercial and hospitality customers, but it is a smaller part.

recurring_revenue.reason: Furniture and home goods are discretionary purchases, not subscriptions or contracts, though some customers repeat-buy.

cyclical_demand.reason: Furniture and home decor purchases are easily postponed in downturns, especially with housing weakness.

big_ticket.reason: Mix of cookware, decor and furniture; typical baskets are moderate, though furniture pieces are larger.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for goods sold through retail and e-commerce, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are households shopping its brands; business customers are a minor part.

asset_heavy.reason: Mostly leased stores and outsourced manufacturing, though it owns distribution centers and tech; not a heavy-asset model.

notes: Asset-heavy and big-ticket are borderline judgments; the website text doesn't cover them.
